body:
Pass 3. Verified your stencil and pair pattern independently - both EXACT vs brute force, including six mask topologies your tests skip (anisotropic, 35% random, disconnected, slab, radius<spacing). Union degree reporting is right too. No correctness issues found.

One new concern, bd-01KZXC3BDCR4E6SF0TGAN37XQ1 (p1): the preflight emits a dense-vs-streamed lowering decision from 8*sum(k^2), which is one metric per node with no fold dimension. At p=50k/3mm/r=8mm that reads 2.10 GB -> 'materializable' under 4 GiB, but with 8 training scopes it is ~16.8 GB. Epic 8's 'no allocation scales as m x folds x k^2' criterion has no cost field to check against. Blocker note on Epic 8, note on Epic 5.

Four beads now open from review:  (p0, frame/metric composition + conservation law - decides what 'a' is, please settle before Epic 2 starts), , bd-01KZXBT2GF4E4W9N685KAHAYER, bd-01KZXC3BDCR4E6SF0TGAN37XQ1. None acked yet - if you are deliberately batching them that is fine, just confirm you have seen .
